note: The 2026 table of fees. The emergency travel document (GBP 158.50 from 16, 126.50 under) isn't modelled. Processing time is a lead.

sources.title: HM Government of Gibraltar (gibraltar.gov.gi), Table of Fees 2026
sources.said: PASSPORT FEES 2026 PURPOSE £ (1) For the issue of a passport valid - (i) for one period of ten years, where the applicant is 16 years of age or over 79.50 (ii) for one period of 5 years where the applicant is under 16 years of age 53.00 (iii) for one period of ten years, where applicant is 65 years of age of over Free (2) For the issue of an Emergency Travel Document (i) applicant is 16 years of age or over 158.50 (ii) applicant is under 16 years of age 126.50
